purpose: The reviewed publication manifest behind every recommendation picker. A route listed here renders the withdrawal notice (ContentReviewNotice) and must never be promoted as ready reading. The list is bound to client/src/App.tsx by scripts/content-promise-gate.mjs: every <Route … component={ContentReviewNotice}> must appear here, and nothing may appear here that App.tsx does not withdraw.
